segments.text: A storm cloud swallows a paraglider and drags her up, higher than Everest. Then she blacks out.
No chance. Nobody passes out up there and lands alive. Let's go look.
February {2007|two thousand seven}, Australia. German champion {Ewa|Eva} {Wisnierska|Vishnyairska} is training for the world championships. A storm is building.
She tries to fly around it. It sucks her in. She spirals down. She keeps going up.
In about fifteen minutes she is nearly ten kilometres high. Hail. Lightning. Almost no air.
She blacks out for over half an hour. Her glider flies on by itself.
Then she wakes up. Covered in ice, still flying. And she lands it.
The same storm kills another pilot, {He|Huh} {Zhongpin|Jong-pin}. He was {42|forty-two}.
She walks away with frostbite. I was wrong. Case closed.
